title: 宝塚記念の後に・声援の成分

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd roars with cheer for Agnes Tachyon's victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She comes back thrilled, realizing the source of her stronger than usual performance came from their cheers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the autumn Tenno Sho and the Arima Kinen still ahead, she comes closer to stepping beyond the limits.
